 ORDER

Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned HCGP for respondents No.1 to 4, 6 and 7 and learned counsel for respondent No.5.
2.

The petitioners are aggrieved by a common cause of action as their lands were acquired for the purpose of Upper Krishna project due to the submergence of the lands into backwaters of Alamatti Mahaveer Halingali S/O Bhimappa ... vs The Secretary on 10 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/169172840/
3 dam and due to rise in its height.
NC: 2024:KHC-D:7696 3.

Respondent No.6 issued a preliminary notification under Section 11(1) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency and Acquisition Rehabilitation Resettlement Act (hereinafter referred to as 'Act of 2013' for brevity) for acquisition.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency and Acquisition Rehabilitation Resettlement Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The details of the lands to the extent and the date of acquisition along with the names are produced in the tabular column at paragraph No.4 in the petition.

Despite the process of issuance of notification under Section 11(1) of the Act of 2013,
the final notification has not been passed by the respondent - authorities.
Hence, petitioners are before this Court seeking a writ of mandamus for a direction to the respondents to issue final notification as the lands have been utilized by the beneficiary.
4. Learned HCGP representing the state and Counsel for respondent No.5 - beneficiary do not object to the issuance of a preliminary notification and the lands being utilized by respondent No.5.

Therefore, in view of submergence of lands of the petitioners and issuance of NC:
2024:KHC-D:7696 the preliminary notification, nothing further remains except for the statutory authorities/state to issue final notification of acquisition, hear the petitioners, notify them and provide suitable opportunities and pass suitable orders in accordance with law and thereafter disburse the compensation in favour of the petitioners without much delay as the petitioners have already lost their lands which are submerged.

5. Accordingly, I pass the following:
ORDER (i) Writ petition is allowed.
(ii) Writ of mandamus is issued to respondents No.4, 6 and 7 to pass suitable orders of acquisition of the lands belonging to the petitioners as stated in this petition under Section 19, by considering the representations produced at Annexure-D, E, F, G, H, J and K and pass suitable orders in accordance with law, within an outer limit of NC:
2024:KHC-D:7696 four weeks from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this order.
Sd/-
